# Aski

> A Swift library and macOS CLI for local image-to-character-art conversion. Convert once to ASCIIGrid, then render plain text, colored attributed text, or CGImage. Also includes tile grids, masks, effects, animation, and MP4/GIF library APIs. Swift 6.3+; iOS 18+, macOS 15+, visionOS 2+; strict Swift 6 concurrency; Apache 2.0. Public and pre-1.0: APIs and output can change between minor releases.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/README.md): Product overview, bundled-image CLI demo, package installation, exact version pinning, and capability boundaries.
- [Character-art examples and recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/guides/character-art-recipes.md): Carina source/output comparison and three rendered recipes (color ASCII, monochrome dithered, braille on a transparent ground) with their exact commands; notes which CLI options require v0.8.0 or later.
- [Documentation hub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/README.md): User guides, architecture, research, and canonical tool inventory.
- [Command-line guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/CommandLine.md): Checkout setup, render/inspect, CLI discovery, PNG widths, transparency, masks, manifests, reusable builds, and troubleshooting.
- [Getting Started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/GettingStarted.md): Image loading, conversion, output formats, palettes, and custom character sets.
- [API catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Aski.md): DocC entry point and public symbol/article navigation. Source uses DocC symbol-link syntax.

## Product guides

- [Rendering](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Rendering.md): Plain text has no color; attributed text and raster output retain color. Library and CLI aspect defaults differ.
- [Character sets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/CharacterSets.md): Built-in ASCII/Unicode sets and runtime rasterization.
- [Algorithms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Algorithms.md): logPolar and dotMatrix, supported controls, oversampling, and measured matcher limitations.
- [Palette matching](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/PaletteMatching.md): Default OKLab metric and explicitly experimental alternatives.
- [Masking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Masking.md): Coverage, image fallbacks, grounds, and CLI photo dissolve.
- [Effects](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Effects.md): Composition, lighting, effect chains, async rendering, and GPU fallback.
- [Animation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Animation.md): Time-based frames from one conversion.
- [Video and GIF](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Video.md): Library round-trips and streaming components; CLI harnesses live under aski lab video.
- [Tiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Tiles.md): Pixel-art, brick, and mosaic cell-grid output.
- [Vesper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Vesper.md): A fixed duotone recipe, not a bundled standalone app.
- [Migration notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/Migrating-to-A1.md): First-public-release migration and clearly labeled private-history transitions.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/CHANGELOG.md): Versioned source and behavior changes; earlier private tags are not available in this repository.

## Automation contracts and implementation

- [Package manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Package.swift): Authoritative toolchain minimums, platforms, products, targets, and dependencies.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/architecture.md): Shared engine, CLI/library boundary, pipeline, and deterministic JSON compatibility policy.
- [Inspection schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/assets/schemas/aski-inspect-v1.schema.json): Versioned inspect JSON; readers must tolerate additive fields.
- [CLI metadata schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/assets/schemas/aski-metadata-v1.schema.json): Versioned command discovery JSON from `aski metadata`.
- [Render manifest schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/assets/schemas/aski-render-manifest-v1.schema.json): Unsigned render record, including paths and optional mask state; not an authenticity proof.
- [Source map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/repo-map.generated.md): Generated symbol-to-file navigation.

## Contributing and research

- [Distribution guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/guides/distribution.md): Local CLI candidate archives with complete resources, an isolated build and relocated smoke check, release provenance, and Swift Package Index DocC configuration. Native validation, indexing, and publication remain separate steps.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup, recorded snapshot toolchain, local verification (including portable just test-infra), isolated DocC exports and output-path migration, docs standards, and release hygiene. No hosted CI workflow is supplied.
- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/AGENTS.md): Hard rules and repository workflow for coding agents; preserve ASCII-prefixed API names.
- [Benchmark validation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/benchmark-validation.md): Complete workload/sample checks, required metrics, retained evidence, the six-workload smoke subset, and the ASKI-86–95 work order. A valid run is not a passing performance budget.
- [Design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/DESIGN.md): Descriptor lineage and sampling limitations, not a universal quality claim.
- [Research index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/Research/README.md): Questions, protocols, evidence, negative results, and retractions. Historical private SHAs are not public replay guarantees.
- [Research methodology](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/agents/research-methodology.md): Frozen controls, exact sampling lattices, pre-registered gates, and no-harm evidence.
- [Paired benchmark readouts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/agents/paired-benchmarks.md): Portable comparison of complete captures, repeated-run noise and explicit adoption limits; links the early video frame-selection contract.
- [Early video selection evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Scripts/research/video-frame-selection.md): ASKI-93 native validation, five paired release runs, unit-aware CSV and portable reproducer; scoped to the frozen synthetic matrix.
- [Prepared footprint evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/benchmark-validation.md#native-replay-result--2026-11-12): ASKI-87 full 52-case paired replay, portable reproducer and explicit adoption exception for one below-bar primary case.
- [Native benchmark validity evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Scripts/research/aski86-2026-11-13/README.md): ASKI-86 genuine native failure/required-metric rejection and observed allocator provenance; full local checks passed, no speedup claim.
- [Allocator lifecycle evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Scripts/research/aski109-2026-11-13/README.md): ASKI-109 reproduces a stale thread-local counter pointer and verifies the correction with native count regressions. Attribution of the earlier ASKI-92 reset crashes remains unresolved.
- [Fixed-palette reuse evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Scripts/research/aski90-2026-11-13/README.md): ASKI-90 rejected under its frozen benefit rule; 114 workloads, five pairs, raw exports and portable reproduction retained.
- [Brightness heap evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Scripts/research/aski88-2026-11-13/README.md): ASKI-88 rejected after five complete pairs; braille improves but standard-character primaries and 17 guards fail. Exact parity, raw exports and portable source/result replay retained.
- [Pulse reuse evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Scripts/research/aski91-2026-11-13/README.md): ASKI-91 pulse-only reuse adopted after exact parity and five pairs; all three overlay primaries and 93 guards pass. Raw exports, replay and limits retained; no direct animated-pulse timing claim.
- [Tile-buffer evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Scripts/research/aski92-2026-11-13/README.md): ASKI-92 paired attempts remain invalid; native parity/gates and 120 separate diagnostic workloads pass. No performance verdict or adoption.
- [GIF memory evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Scripts/research/aski4-2026-11-13/README.md): ASKI-4 incremental appends retain all original ImageIO providers until finalize; candidate correctness passes but bounded lifetime fails.
- [Orientation preparation experiment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Scripts/research/aski2-2026-11-13/README.md): Rejected test-only raw-axis resize/permutation arm; complete exact-raster mismatches, unchanged production video path.
- [Swift 6.4 collision replay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Scripts/research/aski74-2026-11-13/README.md): Unchanged graph and tool checks plus the registered HDR input/gate comparison pass on the recorded host; compressed-output variability and baseline generator drift remain explicit.
- [Rendering task groundwork](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/agents/rendering-groundwork.md): ASKI-91/94/95 contracts, 51 benchmark identities, and measurement/adoption boundaries.
- [Brightness-pool groundwork](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/agents/brightness-pool-groundwork.md): ASKI-88 exact-order contracts, lab-only insertion/heap probes, 42 native workload identities, and measurement/adoption boundaries.
- [HDR research](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/HDRRendering.md): Research-only AskiResearch SPI, not ordinary public API.

- [ASKI-3 color correction protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/docs/Research/2026-11-05-aski3-color-semantics.md): Native color-contract regressions and the paired frozen-selection guard; census evidence does not score color fidelity.

## Interpretation notes

The default color path is linear-light averaging, OKLab Euclidean palette matching, and Ray Trace gamut mapping. The 60D log-polar matcher has measured sparse-support limitations; do not infer reliable orientation preservation from its descriptor size. Lab commands and experimental policies are not blanket production-readiness claims. Build the CLI on a Mac from a checkout or consume a published package tag; v0.7.0 begins the public release history. The CLI's --version reports a Git SHA (or unknown), not a semantic version.
